forecast_obs_notes: The three primary dynamical models (GFS 89.9°F, ECMWF 89.2°F, HRRR 89.9°F) are in remarkably tight agreement near 89-90°F, with only NBM at 87.5°F offering a lower outlier; this level of model consensus is a bullish signal for a high near the upper end of the range.
